purpose: User-triggered Apple Shortcuts request for a read-only TSM hydrology snapshot.

sourceReferences.title: Apple: Request your first API in Shortcuts

stationIds.description: Only include station IDs supported by the deployed endpoint; verify the current API contract before using filters.

setupRequirements: Confirm the TSM API base URL is reachable from the device.
Use HTTPS and the read-only GET endpoint only.
Do not store privileged credentials or long-lived secrets in a shared shortcut.
If the deployment requires interactive OAuth 2, use a server-side supported authentication flow rather than trying to embed that flow in Shortcuts.
Run manually and inspect the JSON response before relying on it.
